summaries.zh: Brings rtk (Rust Token Killer) to DeepSeek Harness. It rewrites supported shell commands through rtk's rules, compresses large tool output via rtk's own method chain (default threshold 2 KB), ships the rtk binary for Windows x64, macOS x64/arm64 and Linux x64/arm64, and surfaces token savings in a UI pill and `/rtk stats`. Every failure path is fail-open: if rtk is missing, times out or returns unexpected output, the original command and output are left untouched. It registers no new tool, repla
